analysis_kind: posthoc inspection of existing summaries; no new simulation
counter_semantics: route_raw_tiles initializes raw_relay_path only in raw-relay pipeline modes; normal distributed OFFLOAD does not initialize it. Transfer completion appends a receiver only when that path is already nonempty. Zero raw_relay_hops therefore cannot establish absence of ordinary compute offload.
observation: The 0.25s run changes MB-scale traffic on many source-to-neighbor edges. This is not floating accumulation noise, while delivery scores and completed task sets are identical.
inference_boundary: Differences are compatible with changed raw-window packet transfers, including multiples of the 6.291456MB two-window payload plus small result traffic. Aggregate edge counters do not identify the individual packets/tasks or prove the trigger. No precise event-level causal attribution is claimed.
remaining_work: A separate follow-up may instrument per-tile normal OFFLOAD decisions/transfers and refine timing; no rerun was performed for this diagnostic.
